changes: Third pass (28 Nov 2026, the author's outside review) applied: 2:00 is one line ('His written statement calls the prize cash.') over the lit page, and the cut goes straight back to the ticket; the spoken 'Even.' is cut and the lit word holds 1.6 s in silence; 4:57-5:21 is one explanation named as unresolved (a 0.6 s beat on the folder, then Australia against Qingdao on his page, 'He doesn't know why. Neither do we.'); 'We won't recreate it.' is cut; Gene's death is the date alone, without the 494 days; the airport line is tightened; the relay line is cut, so Tim's ending comes about 11 s sooner and nothing follows him but YES turning to WHEN?.

Real media inside the cut, not only in its slots: S1 (Tim's 2024 written statement) is lit on the evidence table wherever the narration says 'Tim wrote' or 'he said' of something he wrote (the passport and ticket, the Baiyun market, the fee, the denial, the doctors' findings, the work, the fire), so the documents carry their own share of the runtime.
The hold device as designed: on a statue plate his last words stay alone, low on the frame, through 1.2 s of digital silence; on real footage a dead freeze (00-29).
Chapter supers are SCRIPT_V3's chapter titles in the new text system (the chapter mode of gfx/type.html); dates and places as story type over the establishing shot of each scene.
The cards' line breaks and key words are set per line in the cut plan (`card.keys`); time words (years, dates) take the one accent automatically.
